pod.fixed_is: campaign + mode/smoothing search including the final fit (pod-n896)

pinn.basis: per-phase upper bound: Adam wall time (mps) + the run's whole CPU time (the Adam phase's own CPU time was not recorded); per_lower is the run's CPU time, the per-phase cost if the Adam phase's host CPU time equalled its wall time

break_even_uses: fixed: campaign + model search + final training, for FNO and POD; per: SU2 CPU time, the PINN per phase (see its basis)
bases: per_cpu / per_wall and fixed_cpu / fixed_wall: the same costs on CPU time alone and on wall time alone (the campaign's wall time is summed over its concurrent workers)
